summary: A live groovebox firmware with three synth tracks and a drum track, built for playing and recording by hand rather than loading factory patterns. Still marked beta.
features: 12 engines incl. 6-op FM with DX7 patches, physical models; 153 sounds
37 level-matched drum kits plus user sample and synthesised kits
Hold-a-button layers: 27 punch-in effects, note repeat, erase, mute and fills
64 steps per track with p-locks, micro timing, piano-roll editing; song sections A-D
USB and TRS MIDI in, clock in, sequencer out; USB audio
8 synth voices shared; no Bluetooth MIDI or USB keyboard host

headings: play it live: hold a button, touch a key
lights for playing in the dark 2.3
the menu: settings of the fm-1
usb audio: record the fm-1 on a computer
